text:
Design v2 at b1e885e4 addresses review F1-F12 and the S0 findings:
- 37 fits per dataset, with no split-half fits in the pilot.
- rLSS is condition-centred.
- Whitelist tightened.
- Partial-pilot rule: uniform reverse-index drop, D>=15.
- Determinism test under parallel datasets.
- New slice S11 holds the pre-pilot parity work (O8 reversal).
- Preview-based pilot cost: about 2 core-h central and about 20 upper, re-measured in the rehearsal.
P1 is corrected so that INF3 and FIR parity is also pre-pilot, since they feed the pilot sigma; v2.1 is pending. The F12 and P2/P3 defaults are adopted.
